snippet.title: BURNTCRUST - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4313250/BURNTCRUST/

Jump into the cockpit of your ship and clock in. It's time to make some dough.

BURNTCRUST is a simulator about delivering pizzas on long distance drives through space. Be prepared for a (somewhat) immersive experience. Honk your horn, switch between radio stations, and even dim your lights to better avoid enemy detection in hostile regions. Or travel in safe zones at your own pace and have a relaxing, peaceful time, all while cooking and de
livering delicious pizzas. The perfect game for multitaskers.
